'''Darth Jaga''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Jaga acted as an Imperial advisor to the [[House of Thul]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] and could be found in the Thul palace courtyard when the [[Alderaan Civil War]] was in progress. At one point, Jaga was killed by Republic allied individual and her lightsaber was broken and collected by the individual who was attacking a [[Thul Palace|compound]] belonging to House Thul.
